items.source: The easiest way to expose an HttpRequestHandler bean in Spring style is to define it in Spring's root web application context and define an HttpRequestHandlerServlet in web.xml, pointing to the target HttpRequestHandler bean through its servlet-name which needs to match the target bean name.
items.translation: 以 Spring 风格暴露 HttpRequestHandler bean 的最简单方法是在 Spring 的根 Web 应用程序上下文中定义它，并在 `web.xml` 中定义一个 `HttpRequestHandlerServlet`，通过其 `servlet-name` 指向目标 HttpRequestHandler bean，该名称需要与目标 bean 的名称匹配。

items.source: Typically implemented to generate binary responses directly, with no separate view resource involved. This differentiates it from a Controller within Spring's Web MVC framework. The lack of a ModelAndView return value gives a clearer signature to callers other than the DispatcherServlet, indicating that there will never be a view to render.
items.translation: 通常实现为直接生成二进制响应，不涉及单独的视图资源。这与 Spring Web MVC 框架中的Controller不同。由于没有ModelAndView返回值（见相关文档），除了 DispatcherServlet 之外的调用者可以拥有更清晰的签名，表明将永远不会渲染视图。

items.source: Supported as a handler type within Spring's DispatcherServlet, being able to interact with the dispatcher's advanced mapping and interception facilities. This is the recommended way of exposing an HttpRequestHandler, while keeping the handler implementations free of direct dependencies on a DispatcherServlet environment.
items.translation: 作为 Spring 的DispatcherServlet中的处理器类型得到支持，能够与调度器的先进映射和拦截设施进行交互。这是暴露 HttpRequestHandler 的推荐方式，同时保持处理器实现不直接依赖于 DispatcherServlet 环境。

items.translation: 这是一个功能接口，因此可用作 Lambda 表达式或方法引用的赋值目标。
